g.text: Trace draft follows the photographed sheet; positions are sketch pixels, not GPS.

svg.text: 1 All building locations and roads are traced in the coordinate space of the latest uploaded notebook sketch, not copied from previous AI maps.
2 GP is Penafort Gate beside LASU International School and Staff Quarters. The two TETFund buildings are kept separate.
3 Building sizes are illustrative. This sheet is a topology-first draft, not a scale drawing or validated satellite overlay.
4 Small numbered footprints are fully named in the key. Some shorthand labels remain provisional and require a quick confirmation.
5 The editable SVG contains independent road and building layers. Review its trace comparison before approving 3D modelling.
